title: nicoaira/ginflow pipeline parameters
description: Nextflow pipeline for BLAST-style search over RNA secondary structures using GINFINITY embeddings and FAISS, ScaNN, NGT, cuVS, or quantized-node HNSWLIB seeding.

input.description: Structures table used to build the vector database. Required columns: transcript_id, sequence, secondary_structure. Optional start/end columns (0-based half-open; comma-separated lists for several windows) build one independent subject per window. Extra columns are allowed. Omit when searching an existing --database.

query.description: Structures table to search. Same columns as --input, including optional start/end windows. Each window is an independent query. Omit for a build-only run.

database.description: Existing window database from a previous run (windows.tsv, meta.json, and a vector index). Use with --query. Do not combine with --input.

outdir.description: Output directory for graphs, embeddings, windows, the FAISS database, and seeds.

shard_size.description: Maximum number of input TSV rows per BUILD_RNA_GRAPHS job. A row with several start/end windows expands to several graphs inside that shard.

id_column.description: Column name for the molecule identifier.

sequence_column.description: Column name for the RNA sequence.

structure_column.description: Column name for the dot-bracket secondary structure.

start_column.description: Optional 0-based half-open window start column. Empty cell = full molecule. A comma-separated list (e.g. 34,40) pairs with --end_column to make several independent subjects from one row.

end_column.description: Optional 0-based half-open window end column. Must be present whenever --start_column is. Same number of comma-separated values as start.

no_slices.description: Ignore start/end columns and encode every row as a full molecule.

keep_paired_neighbours.description: For a start/end window, keep bases outside the core that are paired with a core nucleotide so they take part in message passing. Embeddings still contain only the core.

context_hops.description: How far to expand around crossing-pair partners when --keep_paired_neighbours is set. 1 = the partner only; higher values also take neighbouring nucleotides. Does not change embedding length.

delimiter.description: Field delimiter of the structures table.

embed_device.description: Documented embed device. CUDA requires -profile gpu, which sets accelerator=1 on EMBED_RNA_GRAPHS and selects the GPU Wave image.

ginfinity_full_precision.description: Pass --full-precision to ginfinity embed-graphs. CPU runs use full-precision model inference by default; the GPU profile disables this so GPU runs use float16 unless explicitly enabled. The dashed CLI spelling --ginfinity-full-precision is also accepted.

window_size.description: Sliding-window length in nucleotides. Each window is the concatenation of this many 128-d residue vectors.

seed_k.description: Maximum neighbours kept per query window before applying --seed_min_similarity.

seed_min_similarity.description: Minimum cosine similarity (L2-normalized window inner product) required to keep a seed.

search_shard_size.description: Query records per index-search job. Defaults to --shard_size. Does not change database graph/embed shards. Ignored when --input and --query are the same file (search reuses the database shards).

node_quantization_k.description: Requested number of cosine k-means node centroids for --index hnswlib. The effective value is capped by the available training node vectors.

node_quantization_sample_size.description: Maximum number of node vectors sampled to fit the HNSWLIB quantizer.

node_quantization_niter.description: Spherical k-means iterations for node quantization.

node_quantization_seed.description: Random seed for reproducible node centroid fitting.

hnswlib_m.description: HNSWLIB graph degree for the quantized candidate index.

hnswlib_random_seed.description: Random seed for reproducible HNSWLIB graph construction.

hnswlib_num_threads.description: HNSWLIB worker threads. Zero uses the library default/all available threads.

hnswlib_candidate_k.description: Number of compact centroid-code HNSW candidates retrieved before keeping --seed_k results or optionally reranking with the original float16 windows. Applies to --index hnswlib.

hnswlib_rerank.description: Rerank the compact HNSW candidate pool with the original normalized float16 window embeddings before writing seeds. This preserves quantization for candidate selection only and applies to --index hnswlib.

index.description: Index library used to build and search the window database. faiss (default) uses --faiss_index, scann uses Google ScaNN, ngt uses --ngt_index, cuvs uses --cuvs_index, and hnswlib quantizes nodes into centroid codes before HNSWLIB candidate search. Unused library-specific flags are warned at launch. See docs/indexes.md.

ngt_index.description: NGT structure. ngt is the regular graph, qg is the quantized graph, and qbg is the quantized blob graph. Applies to --index ngt. CPU-only.

ngt_edge_size_for_creation.description: Initial graph edges per node during NGT construction. Higher values can improve recall at build-time and index-size cost. Applies to --index ngt with ngt or qg.

ngt_edge_size_for_search.description: Graph edges explored per node during NGT search, and the regular-graph search edge setting written at build time. Applies to all NGT structures; the build-time setting is used by ngt and qg.

ngt_num_threads.description: Threads used by ngtpy batch insertion/index construction. Applies to --index ngt with ngt or qg.

ngt_max_no_of_edges.description: Maximum NGT edges explored at search time; when building qg/qbg it is also passed to qbg build-qg/build -E and used as the QBG Python loader's max_no_of_edges. Unset uses --ngt_edge_size_for_search for search and the current QBG loader fallback of 128. Applies to all NGT structures.

ngt_num_of_search_objects.description: Initial candidate objects explored by NGT's two-stage search. Higher values generally improve recall at search-time cost. Applies to all NGT structures.

ngt_search_range_coefficient.description: NGT search epsilon/search-range coefficient. Unset uses the binding default (0.1 for regular NGT, 0.02 for QG/QBG). Applies to all NGT structures.

ngt_blob_search_range_coefficient.description: Additional QBG blob-stage search epsilon. Unset leaves the QBG binding default. Applies only to qbg.

ngt_search_radius.description: Optional maximum NGT distance/radius for search. Unset means no radius limit. Applies to all NGT structures.

ngt_result_expansion.description: Expansion ratio for approximate quantized search candidates. Higher values can improve recall at search-time cost. Applies to qg and qbg; unset preserves binding defaults.

ngt_exploration_size.description: QBG exploration size for the blob-graph search. Higher values can improve recall at search-time cost. Applies only to qbg.

ngt_exact_result_expansion.description: QBG exact-result expansion factor used after approximate search. Applies only to qbg.

ngt_num_of_probes.description: QBG probe count for the two-stage search. One probe avoids empty results on small collections with current NGT releases; higher values can improve recall at cost. Applies only to qbg.

ngt_qg_subvector_dimensions.description: QG quantizer subvector dimension passed to qbg create-qg -Q. Unset uses qbg's dimension heuristic. Applies only to qg.

ngt_qbg_subvectors.description: QBG local quantizer division/subvector count passed to qbg create -N. Unset uses qbg's default. Applies only to qbg.

ngt_qbg_cluster_data_type.description: QBG cluster/codebook storage type passed to qbg create -C. pq4 is compact; sq8 can improve quantization fidelity at higher storage cost. Applies only to qbg.

cuvs_index.description: cuVS GPU structure. cagra is a GPU graph, ivf is IVF-Flat, and ivf-pq is compressed IVF. Applies to --index cuvs and requires -profile gpu.

cuvs_n_lists.description: cuVS IVF coarse clusters. Applies to --index cuvs with ivf or ivf-pq. Unset = min(4*sqrt(n), n).

cuvs_n_probes.description: cuVS IVF clusters searched per query. Applies to --index cuvs with ivf or ivf-pq. Unset = min(20, n_lists).

cuvs_pq_bits.description: Bits per product-quantization code. Applies to --index cuvs with ivf-pq.

cuvs_pq_dim.description: cuVS ivf-pq compressed dimension. 0 selects the cuVS heuristic; otherwise use a dimension compatible with the vector dimension.

cuvs_intermediate_graph_degree.description: cagra intermediate graph degree. Higher values can improve recall at build-time memory cost.

cuvs_graph_degree.description: cagra final graph degree. Higher values can improve recall at search-time memory cost.

cuvs_build_algo.description: cagra initial graph builder. nn_descent is a practical GPU default; ace is for datasets that need partitioned builds.

cuvs_itopk_size.description: cagra intermediate search result count. Higher values usually improve recall at search-time cost.

faiss_index.description: FAISS index type. Applies to: --index faiss. Default flatip is exact cosine search. GPU (--faiss_gpu) supports flatip, flatl2, ivfflat, ivfpq, and ivfsq only. See docs/indexes.md.

faiss_gpu.description: Build and search the FAISS index on GPU when the type supports it. Applies to: --index faiss with flatip, flatl2, ivfflat, ivfpq, or ivfsq. Requires -profile gpu. Error if the profile is missing, the FAISS type has no GPU implementation, or --index is scann.

faiss_nlist.description: IVF coarse centroids. Applies to: --index faiss with ivfflat, ivfpq, ivfsq, ivfpqr. Unset = min(4*sqrt(n), n/39, n).

faiss_nprobe.description: IVF lists visited at search time. Applies to: --index faiss with ivfflat, ivfpq, ivfsq, ivfpqr. Unset = min(8, nlist) at build, or the value stored in meta.json at search.

faiss_pq_m.description: Product-quantizer subvectors. Applies to: --index faiss with pq, ivfpq, ivfpqr. Must divide the window dimension (1408 when --window_size 11).

faiss_pq_nbits.description: Bits per PQ subquantizer. Applies to: --index faiss with pq, ivfpq, ivfpqr.

faiss_pq_m_refine.description: Extra PQ codes used to rerank ivfpqr hits. Applies to: --index faiss with ivfpqr.

faiss_hnsw_m.description: HNSW graph neighbors per node (M). Applies to: --index faiss with hnsw.

faiss_hnsw_ef_construction.description: HNSW construction exploration depth. Applies to: --index faiss with hnsw.

faiss_hnsw_ef_search.description: HNSW search exploration depth. Applies to: --index faiss with hnsw. Also applied at search time.

faiss_lsh_nbits.description: LSH code length in bits. Applies to: --index faiss with lsh. Unset = 2 * window_dim.

faiss_sq_type.description: Scalar quantizer width. Applies to: --index faiss with sq or ivfsq.

scann_reorder.description: ScaNN exact-reorder pool after asymmetric hashing. Applies to: --index scann. Raised to at least --seed_k. Unused for brute-force ScaNN (n < 20k unless --scann_leaves is set).

scann_ah_dim.description: ScaNN asymmetric-hash dimensions per block. Applies to: --index scann. 2 is the official recommendation.

scann_anisotropic.description: ScaNN anisotropic vector-quantization threshold. Applies to: --index scann.

scann_soar.description: Enable ScaNN SOAR spilling on partitioned indexes. Applies to: --index scann when a tree is used.

scann_leaves.description: ScaNN tree leaves. Applies to: --index scann. Unset = sqrt(n) when n >= 100k. Setting this forces a partitioned index even for small databases.

scann_leaves_to_search.description: ScaNN leaves visited at search time. Applies to: --index scann when a tree is used. Unset = min(8, leaves).

cluster_span.description: Maximum nucleotide gap, on query and target, between a seed and the current cluster box.

cluster_min_seeds.description: Minimum seeds required to keep a cluster.

cluster_diagonal_tolerance.description: Allowed diagonal drift (query_start - target_start) when adding a seed.

cluster_max_diagonal_span.description: Maximum diagonal breadth of a cluster. 0 disables the cap.

cluster_max_seed_rank.description: Ignore FAISS hits worse than this rank. 0 keeps every seed.

align_pad.description: Nucleotides of context added on each side of a cluster before GINFINITY-SW.

align_max_cells.description: Maximum DP cells (crop length product) allowed for one cluster.

evd_samples.description: Reverse-sequence null alignments used to fit Karlin–Altschul λ and K.

evd_max_length.description: Crop each null sequence to this length so EVD calibration stays O(L^2).

evd_seed.description: RNG seed for reverse-sequence null sampling.

plot_backend.description: Draw aligned regions with RNArtistCore 2Ds, a unified R4RNA alignment arc plot, both, or skip plotting.

plot_sw.description: Draw crop cosine and substitution-score matrices, with the Smith–Waterman traceback on the score plot.

plot_max_pairs.description: Maximum alignment pairs to plot per query. RNArtistCore writes query and target 2Ds; R4RNA writes one alignment arc plot; SW writes cosine and score matrices.

plot_highlight_colour.description: Colour of the aligned span, shared R4RNA pairs, matching bases, and the SW traceback. Default is nf-core green.

report_theme.description: Colour theme of report.html. Light (gray-100 page, white cards) is the default; pass dark for a gray-900 report. The page also has a theme toggle.
